correctness.rationale: Each inactive vertex of the four-regular cube activates exactly when its residual degree is at most one, so the synchronous dynamics are parallel deletion of leaves and isolates. A cycle never disappears, and any nonempty forest has a deletable vertex. A nontrivial tree's diameter drops by two on a leaf-deletion round when the diameter is at least two; an isolated vertex or a single edge takes one round. This gives 1+floor(d/2) with the stated empty boundary. Monotonicity reduces seed minimality to single deletions, or maximality of the residual induced forest: adding a vertex to a forest creates a cycle exactly when two of its neighbors already lie in one component. An independent exhaustive synchronous enumerator reproduced 936 minimal masks with the three coefficients 8, 160 and 768; all six representative orbit sizes, component-order lists and diameters reproduced. Translations and coordinate permutations give the full group: an automorphism fixing zero permutes its four neighbors, and distances to zero and the neighbors recover every vertex. The eight parity/antipodal patterns infect the opposite parity in round one and then the omitted vertices; they exhaust the size-six row.
